summary: Design and operate a software-defined NVMe-over-Fabrics storage platform beneath Supabase Postgres, including durability, QoS and snapshots.
requirements: 7+ years in software engineering with production storage systems; distributed block storage, NVMe/TCP or NVMe-oF, Linux storage internals, Go plus C/C++/Rust, fio/pgbench/eBPF/perf, durability tradeoffs, Kubernetes controllers/CSI and production on-call. SPDK/RDMA/Postgres internals preferred.
conditions: Full-time globally remote, asynchronous work. Production on-call and incident response are part of the role. Annual offsites are listed. Salary and visa sponsorship not disclosed.
